profile.headline: Software Engineer at Mailchimp | Full-stack (React, PHP, Node) | 10 years across retail, fintech and SaaS
profile.summary: I'm a full-stack engineer with 10 years of experience. At Mailchimp I work on the core email team, building the email editor in React and PHP. Before that I spent five years at two software consultancies, shipping products for client teams in consumer goods, restaurants, credit and financial data, and solar energy, and two years on engineering teams at The Home Depot. More than four of those consultancy years were fully remote. I also led Georgia Tech's web development boot camp for a year, which taught me how to explain hard things simply. I build with AI coding tools daily and care most about shipping working software quickly.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description: Core email team. Build and maintain the email editor used by Mailchimp customers, in React and PHP.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description: Fully remote. Built web applications for client teams in credit and financial data, solar energy and small-business services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built custom software for enterprise clients in consumer goods. Fully remote from March 2020.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Lead instructor for Georgia Tech professional education program that teaches HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, C#, Bootstrap, Node.js, React.js, Express.js, MERN Stack, Database Theory,  Handlebars, MySQL, Command Line, Git, Agile practices, and more.

positions.title: Student
positions.description: I was enrolled as a Web Development Immersive student at General Assembly. It was a 12-week course that covered the fundamentals and beyond for web-development, during which I learned and implemented best practices for product development, front-end development, and back-end development. The languages/topics covered included: Angular.js, MongoDB, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, Heroku, git, Node.js, Express.js, Ruby, Ruby on Rails.

positions.title: Expat
positions.description: Backpacked throughout SE Asia and other countries, immersing myself in their respective cultures. Spent 150+ hours becoming familiar with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript through online resources and completed 16 projects using Code Academy's PRO tutorial.

positions.title: Personal Trainer
positions.description:
I consulted and maintained health programs for 10-12 clients at a time (online and in person).
I also tracked clients’ results and altered their training programs based on respective needs and goals.

company.name: Independent Personal Trainer and Fitness Instructor

positions.title: Wheel-Alignment Specialist
positions.description: I performed wheel alignments and performance testing of three vehicle models. I also served as a mentor for newer employees and was consistently recognized as top performer.
